clue.text: By MEDICINE HAT out of NAUGHTY GIRL. No good to backers. Slow and sleepy. Cash bid of ten pounds would tempt owner
By HESITANT HERO out of DUMB BLONDE. An erratic brute, damned by bettors, lauded by bookies.
By NO CHANGE out of STEPMOTHER. A strong finisher, but all too apt to tarry the first furlong
By POURBOIRE out of PHILADELPHIA. a flyer, but addicted to bumping and boring A pet aversion of knowing riders.
By BRIAN'S EMU out of NAUGHTY LASS. More suited to a cab, I'm sure. An absolute certainty for a dip in the water.
By IL PONDEROSO out of BOOMPS-A- DAISY. Usually lands in the soup, but immersion does not damp his spirits.
By BACCHUS out of CHORUS GIRL. Said
By WATER BUTT out of SALTPETRE. Not a chaser; a common or garden hay masticator merely.
By RIBBON DEVELOPMENT out of SOHO FLOWER. Is that Pegasus striking water from the earth, or the old nag falling at the canal jump?
By SUNDIAL out of FRUIT TART. Bought for five guineas, but hasn't redeemed her price yet, and may slump further.
